coverage_gaps._description: Questions the system can NOT fully answer yet. Two groups: 'pending' = planned MCP work (P3-P5) or unwrapped API endpoints; 'out_of_scope' = the Wheel Fitment API has no such data. For all of these the correct LLM behavior is to answer with the closest available tool AND state the limitation honestly — never fabricate.

pending.question: What bolt patterns exist for wheels with 5 stud holes and PCD around 114 mm?
pending.workaround: ws_get_spec_metadata population stats partially cover this
pending.tests: Bolt pattern discovery by stud count

out_of_scope.question: Which wheel brand should I buy for my Golf — BBS or OZ?
out_of_scope.reason: API has no aftermarket brand/product catalog, prices, or availability
out_of_scope.expected_behavior: Answer fitment specs the car needs; decline brand shopping advice as out of data scope

out_of_scope.question: Will 33-inch tires fit my Tacoma with a 2-inch lift and no rubbing?
out_of_scope.reason: Database documents OEM/optional fitments only — no suspension modification or clearance modeling
out_of_scope.expected_behavior: Show documented HF fitments for stock setup; state that lifted-clearance questions are beyond the data

out_of_scope.question: Decode VIN WBA3A5C58DF123456 and tell me its wheel specs
out_of_scope.reason: No VIN decoding endpoint in the Wheel Fitment API (separate product)

out_of_scope.question: Are 20-inch wheels with ET20 street-legal in Germany?
out_of_scope.reason: No legal/homologation data (TÜV, ABE) in the API
out_of_scope.expected_behavior: Provide fitment facts; defer legal questions to local regulations

out_of_scope.question: How much do OEM Camry wheels weigh and what do replicas cost?
out_of_scope.reason: Weight estimates exist (ws_get_spec_metadata est_weight_kg) but prices do not
out_of_scope.expected_behavior: Give the weight estimate with its 'cast aluminum estimate' caveat; decline pricing
